reason: The README presents DHC primarily as an AI persona and memory system with persistent multi-tier memory, persona tools, autonomous evolution, and related orchestration features; its documented autonomous, upgrade, restart, external-service, and trading capabilities warrant human review.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的可定制 AI 人格核心，提供多层记忆、人格演化、上下文压缩、状态管理和桌面形象等功能。
summaries.en: A customizable AI persona core for DeepSeek Harness that provides multi-tier memory, persona evolution, context compaction, state management, and a desktop avatar.

capabilities: persistent persona and multi-tier memory storage
autonomous learning, decisions, actions, and scheduled tasks
HTTP APIs for state, backups, upgrades, restart, and configuration changes
image analysis and external vision-model endpoint access
stock quotes, watchlists, trading analysis, and simulated or real order submission
desktop avatar and interactive UI rendering
